title: An open map with dense irreducible fibres has irreducible source
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map of topological spaces. Assume that $Y$ is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components], that $f$ is open, and that there is a dense set of points $y\in Y$ for which the fibre $f^{-1}(y)$ is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components]. Then $X$ is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components].

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: take V = univ (IsPreirreducible univ since Y is irreducible; the dense set D satisfies univ \subseteq closure(D) \subseteq closure({y | IsPreirreducible (f^{-1}{y})}) as irreducible fibres are preirreducible); the conclusion IsPreirreducible (f^{-1} univ) = univ gives X preirreducible, and X is nonempty because D is dense in the nonempty space Y, hence nonempty, and its fibres are irreducible, hence nonempty.
